test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom or phrase to fill in the blank in the given sentence.**

Sweety has been _______ since her painting won first prize.
solution:
The correct answer is: **walking on air **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Walking on air**" means to be extremely happy or elated. (अत्यधिक प्रसन्न या प्रसन्न होना)

 
 
• **For example**: *After receiving the good news, she felt like she was walking on air.*
 
 
 
• This phrase is often used to describe the feeling of great joy or excitement after achieving a goal or receiving good news.
 
• In the given sentence, Sweety is feeling extremely happy and elated since her painting won first prize.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Walking on eggshells**" means to be very cautious or careful in one's actions or words, usually because of a tense or sensitive situation. (आमतौर पर किसी तनावपूर्ण या संवेदनशील स्थिति के कारण किसी के कार्यों या शब्दों में बहुत सतर्क या सावधान रहना)
 
• "**Waiting in the wings**" means to be ready and waiting for an opportunity to take action or to step forward. (तैयार रहना और कार्रवाई करने या आगे बढ़ने के अवसर की प्रतीक्षा करना)
 
• "**Walking into the lion's den**" means to willingly enter a dangerous or challenging situation. (किसी खतरनाक या चुनौतीपूर्ण स्थिति में स्वेच्छा से प्रवेश करना)
